title: Mosquito Beekeeper Notification
description: This Service Request is used to COLLECT Beekeeper contact information. A Beekeeper is defined as a person who keeps, raises, and cares for honeybees. This Service Request will allow the City of Dallas to provide "notification" to Beekeepers before ground and aerial spraying take place for mosquito abatement. The City of Dallas does not respond to complaints regarding bees, please contact a private exterminator for pest control. If the concern is regarding mosquitoes, please submit a Code Concern Service Request Type (and select pest/bugs). The estimated response time for this service request is 48 hours.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request to receive advance mosquito-spraying notifications as a beekeeper.
actions.why: For a beekeeper, meaning a person who keeps, raises, and cares for honeybees, to provide contact information so the City of Dallas can notify them before ground or aerial mosquito-abatement spraying. The 311 request form asks the property type and whether notice is wanted for aerial spraying, ground spraying, or both. The 311 request form says the City gives 4–7 hours of advance notice for ground spraying and 12–24 hours for aerial spraying. Ground spraying requires an email address; the aerial-spraying choice allows Email or Phone, while choosing Both collects an email address.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Mosquito Beekeeper Notification" requests does not apply to complaints about bees or concerns about mosquitoes. If you need pest control for bees, then contact a private exterminator. If the concern is mosquitoes, then submit a "Code Concerns" 311 request instead and select pest/bugs.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "City Code Violations" > Choose "Mosquito Beekeeper Notification"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "City Code Violations" > Choose "Mosquito Beekeeper Notification"
